headline: Ulta Beauty Could Turn Target Partnership Exit into a Revenue Growth Opportunity, Analyst Says
summary: BofA Securities reiterates a Buy rating on Ulta Beauty (NYSE: ULTA), citing $650M in target GMV recapture opportunities. Read the analyst breakdown on revenue and EBIT growth.
